title: Easter egg hunts, festivals set for Anderson, Greenville, Spartanburg - NewsBreak
text:
By Terry Benjamin II ,
16 hours ago
With spring in full bloom and Easter weekend around the corner, communities across the Upstate are gearing up for a slate of egg hunts, festivals, and family-friendly celebrations.
More than a dozen Easter Egg Events will take place over the coming two weeks in Anderson, Greenville, and Spartanburg counties.
Easter will take place on April 5 in 2026.
From traditional church lawn egg hunts to large-scale community events in local parks, this roundup highlights when and where families can join the fun, what to expect at each stop, and how organizers are putting their own spin on a classic Easter tradition.
Here are some of the upcoming Easter Egg Hunting events in Anderson, Greenville, and Spartanburg:
More: After $5.8M in renovations, Cater's Lake Park reopens. See new look
Spartanburg County Spartanburgers Easter Egg Hunt: April 5, 2:05 p.m. to 8 p.m. After the Hub City Spartanburger plays the Fredrick Keys, fans will be able to stay for a post-game Easter egg hunt out on the field for the kids, presented by Eggs Up Grill. Special golden eggs will be hidden. Tickets for the event are $10 and up . It will take place at Fifth Third Park, located at 300 W. Henry St. in Spartanburg. Easter Egg Scramble: April 4, 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. The hunt is hosted by the Spartanburg County Parks Department at Va-Du-Mar McMillan Park, located at 591 McMillin Boulevard, Boiling Springs. This year's event will begin with Easter egg hunts for those with special needs of all ages, followed by Easter egg hunts for all other participants ages 12 and under. From 9 a.m. to 9:30 a.m., the tennis and pickleball courts will host sensory-friendly hunts for various ages. From 10:15 a.m. to 12:30 p.m., the courts will be non-sensory friendly. The cost is $3 per person. Parents, guardians, and non-participants can enter for free. Scarlett's Boutique and Home Easter Egg Hunt for Children: March 28, 11:30 a.m. to 3 p.m. The boutique will host a free easter egg hunt. The event will have face painting, Easter Bunny photos, and a hunt for two age groups. At 1 p.m., there will be a hunt for two-year-olds to four-year-olds, with only one guardian allowed per child. At 1:30 p.m., there will be a hunt for five-year-olds to eight-year-olds. The event will provide bags for egg gathering. The event is free with a reservation and will take place at 3275 Reidville Road. Greenville County Egg Hunt at the Kroc Center : March 27, 4:45 p.m. to 7 p.m. The free Egg Hunt check-in runs from 4:45 p.m. to 5:10 p.m. at the Kroc Soccer Field and will move indoors if the weather turns bad, with the hunt starting promptly at 5:15 p.m. Concessions begin at 5:30 p.m., including a $5 combo meal. Egg baskets will be provided. The event will be at 424 Westfield St., Greenville. Egg Hunt at Mountain Creek Baptist Church: March 28, 10 a.m. to 11:30 a.m. The event is for kids ages birth through fifth grade. The free event will be located at 255 W. Mountain Creek Church Road in Greenville. They ask guests to bring their own baskets. West Village Post Acute Easter Egg Hunt: April 3, 3 p.m. to 5 p.m. The egg hunt will include food for guests. The event is located at 8 N. Texas Ave. Palmetto Spring Fest: April 4, 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. Palmetto Baptist Church will host an event that'll have carnival games, bounce houses, age-specific egg hunts, free candy, a soccer 3v3 speed tournament, and food. The event is free and will be located at 2730 Anderson Road in Greenville. Larkins Sawmill Easter Egg Hunt and Brunch: April 5, 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. Ticket prices vary by time of the egg hunt . The event features an open buffet, egg hunts at 10:30 a.m., 12:15 p.m., and 1:45 p.m. They ask guests to bring their own Easter basket. The event is located at 22 Graves Drive in Greenville. Anderson County Denver Downs Easter Festival: March 28 through April 5, Monday-Saturday: 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. and Sunday: 1 p.m. to 5 p.m. The farm will host their annual egg hunt this year at a cost of $15.95 . Second Annual Egg Hunt for the Cancer Association of Anderson: March 21, 10:30 a.m.- 11:30 a.m. Locke & Key Associates and Realtor David Locke will host an egg hunt with more than 2,000 eggs, divided by age. The event takes place at 1902 Lynn Avenue in Anderson. Tickets are $30 each, and there are a maximum of 60 slots. New Spring Church Easter Eggstavaganza: April 4, starting at 10:30 a.m. The church is accepting pre-filled plastic eggs as donations, preferably with no chocolate. The church is asking people to sign up if they wish to volunteer at the event. The Easter event will take place at the church at 2940 Concord Road in Anderson.
